input.command:
cd /home/noah/propscan && PYTHONPATH=/home/noah/propscan/src python3 -c "
from propscan.core import PropScan
scanner = PropScan()

# Test with a proprietary package
proprietary_package = {
    'name': 'google-chrome',
    'display_name': 'Google Chrome',
    'version': '91.0',
    'manager': 'pacman',
    'licenses': ['Proprietary']
}

print('Is Chrome proprietary?', scanner.detector.is_proprietary(proprietary_package))
print('Detection reason:', scanner.detector.get_detection_reason(proprietary_package))

# Test fallback detection
unknown_proprietary = {
    'name': 'google-chrome',
    'display_name': 'Google Chrome',
    'version': '91.0',
    'manager': 'pacman',
    'licenses': ['unknown']
}

print('Is Chrome (unknown license) proprietary?', scanner.detector.is_proprietary(unknown_proprietary))
print('Detection reason:', scanner.detector.get_detection_reason(unknown_proprietary))
"
